judgmentMethod: Agent-authored source-description relevance judgments, frozen before any ranking evaluation. The author read the development fixture only to exclude its food and restaurant families, inspected raw USDA/restaurant data and canonical IDs, and did not inspect ranker implementation or search results while choosing queries or labels. This is a small source-grounded held-out stress set, not human-rated or sampled user traffic. No tuning is permitted against this set.
